$comment: Sample projects (AFD-290): what a new project gets when it starts from a sample, in a project's layout. `from` is a file or folder under samples/, `to` the path in the project (empty: the project's root). Ansible Flow Server reads this from @ansible-flow/assets.

projects.name: Hello, Ansible
projects.description: The smallest useful flow: reach each host, read a few facts and say hello. Runs on localhost.

projects.name: Edge baseline
projects.description: NTP, AAA and syslog baseline for edge switches with a backup first and rollback, and the playbooks and roles it binds (fictional switches, simulated locally).

projects.name: Firewall firmware upgrade
projects.description: Pre-checks, a backup, an approval, polling until the device is back, post-checks and rollback. Steps are drafts: runs as a skeleton on localhost.
